name: Source select
description: A room with four sources on an interlock (pressing one releases the others), a power toggle, a volume slider that echoes back, and the four source names sent to the panel as text when the program starts.
tryIt: Open the test panel on IP ID 03, press digital 1 to 4 and watch only one stay lit, press digital 5 to toggle power, move analog 1 and see it come back, and read serial 1 to 4.
